voiceInstructions:
Speak in polished British English.
Use a confident, warm, calm and trustworthy male delivery.
Sound like a narrator presenting a premium B2B SaaS CRM and automation product.
Use clear pronunciation, natural conversational pacing and subtle energy.
The delivery should feel modern and professional, suitable for a LinkedIn business advertisement.
Pause naturally at commas and full stops.
Emphasise key business outcomes without sounding theatrical.
Give slightly stronger emphasis to phrases including:
less administration
faster recruitment
greater visibility
successful hire
recruit, automate and grow
evantixgroup.com
Do not sound robotic, aggressive, overly excited, overly dramatic or like a hard-sell salesperson.

segments.text: Every growing care and recruitment business eventually reaches the same point.
Too many systems, too many manual tasks, and too much time spent chasing information.
New enquiries arrive, but slow responses and missed follow-ups allow valuable opportunities to disappear.
Candidate information becomes buried across emails, spreadsheets, messages and disconnected applications.
Meet Evantix. One connected CRM and automation system, built around the way your business operates.
Every new application and enquiry is captured automatically, with no manual data entry required.
Candidate details, experience, availability, documents and communication history are organised in one place.
Your team can quickly identify the strongest candidates using clear suitability and priority scoring.
Personalised emails and text messages are sent within seconds of an application being received.
Candidates can book their own interview using your team's live calendar availability.
Every candidate moves through a clear recruitment pipeline, from first application to successful hire.
Automated follow-ups continue working, even when your recruitment team is busy.
DBS checks, right-to-work documents, references, training and compliance records are tracked without spreadsheets.
Tasks are automatically assigned to the right team member at the right time.
Clients, vacancies, candidates and revenue opportunities are managed together.
Suitable candidates can be matched with open roles faster, while your team remains in control of every final decision.
Live dashboards reveal response times, interviews, hires, conversions and hours saved.
The result is less administration, faster recruitment and greater visibility across your entire business.
From attracting and qualifying candidates, to contacting, booking, verifying and hiring.
Evantix helps your business recruit, automate and grow. Visit evantixgroup.com and book your free strategy call.
